Vault PIN.

### ⚠️ Breaking changes
- Locked notes now need a **vault PIN**; you'll be asked to set one. Biometrics are optional on top.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Share and confirm dialogs no longer get clipped by the note grid.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.1.5...v0.1.6](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.1.5...v0.1.6)
